verdict.rationale: Calendly's API lets developers programmatically read Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker data (calendly-docs-1) and view availability data (calendly-docs-24, calendly-docs-47), which provides some data portability via JSON API responses, but there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature, no mention of open-format full account export, and no account-deletion/data-takeout workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit full-account data export tool, documented open format (CSV/JSON dump) for all user data, and any GDPR-style data portability/account closure feature.
